composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Normalize the telephone (strip non-digits, require exactly 10) first: it is the sole
# @RequestBody binding and must run before the DTO's digits-only pattern check would reject
# the raw input. It publishes the normalized body for the validate step.
normalize:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerTelephone
  next: normalizeEmail

# Normalize the optional email (validate its format when present, then lower-case it) on the
# already-bound body, before validation and any persistence.
normalizeEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerEmail
  next: normalizeAddress

# Normalize the address (trim/collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand abbreviations) on the
# already-bound body, before validation. Running before validate means an address blank once
# normalized is rejected as a missing required field, and every later address comparison
# (duplicate household, shared household id) sees the normalized form.
normalizeAddress:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerAddress
  next: validate

# Validate so a missing/blank required field is a 400 listing those fields, before any
# entity is built or persisted.
validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  next: unique

# Reject a telephone already used by another owner (comparing normalized telephones) with a
# 409, before any entity is built or persisted. Reads the same transaction as the writes.
unique:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueOwnerTelephone
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: uniqueHousehold

# Reject a lastName+address already used by another owner (compared case-insensitively with
# collapsed whitespace) with a 409, unless the request opts in with sharesHousehold=true.
# Runs before any entity is built or persisted, in the same transaction as the writes.
uniqueHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueOwnerHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold
assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: defaultRegistrationDate

# Default the registration date to the server's current date when the body supplied none,
# before the owner is persisted. A supplied date is kept.
defaultRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.DefaultOwnerRegistrationDate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCustomerCode

# Assign the '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' customer code, where NNNN is one more than the current owner
# count. Reads the count in the same transaction as the write so the sequence is consistent.
assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner, stored in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 9
          maxLength: 16
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; when omitted the server's current date is used.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-18'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner shares the same
            lastName and address (i.e. they live in the same household). Write-only; not stored
            or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Server-assigned customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household (same lastName
                and address). Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true.
              type: string
              example: '9f2c1a...'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32

## Change: `namesakeCount` on created owners

The `POST /api/owners` response (and every subsequent `GET /api/owners/{id}`) now reports `namesakeCount` — the number of existing owners that already shared the new owner's `firstName` and `lastName` (compared case-insensitively) at the moment of creation.

**Where each piece lives:**

- **New step function** `AssignOwnerNamesakeCount` — its single responsibility is to count existing namesakes off the repository and stamp the built entity. It runs *before* the owner is persisted, so `findAll()` returns only prior owners and the new owner isn't counted against itself, matching the "before this create" requirement. The name-matching predicate is a small private helper.
- **Pipeline wiring** — inserted the step into `owners.POST.yml` after `assignHousehold` and before `defaultRegistrationDate`, under `govern: [ transaction ]` like its neighbours, so the count reads consistently within the create transaction.
- **Persistence** — the value must survive to the later `GET`, so I added a `namesakeCount` field/column: `Owner` entity (`@Column(name = "namesake_count")` + accessors) and the `owners` table in all four schemas (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres).
- **API/DTO** — added a read-only `namesakeCount` integer to the `Owner` schema in `openapi.yml`; the generated `OwnerDto` and MapStruct's `OwnerMapper` pick it up automatically by name, so no mapper changes were needed.

I reused the existing `Out<T>`/`@Val` state-passing convention and the same `findAll()` counting pattern already used by `AssignOwnerCustomerCode`/`AssignOwnerHousehold`, rather than duplicating logic or overloading an existing class.
